udt_struct_v0.doc: Mirrors the market contract's `Config` with the same XDR encoding, so the\nmarket constructor decodes it directly. The field docs are the market's.
udt_struct_v0.name: Config

fields.doc: ADL clear target on the same measure (`SCALAR_18`). In\n`[MIN_ADL_CLEAR, adl_max_pnl]`.
fields.name: adl_clear_target

fields.doc: ADL trigger (`SCALAR_18`). A side arms when its pending PnL over half\nthe vault exceeds this. In `[MIN_ADL_TRIGGER, max_pnl_trader]`, below 1.
fields.name: adl_max_pnl

fields.doc: Borrowing-rate slope below the kink (`SCALAR_18`, per second). The\nrate there is `borrow_rate * utilization`.
fields.name: borrow_rate

fields.doc: Deposit fill fee rate on moved assets (`SCALAR_18`).
fields.name: deposit_fee

fields.doc: Flat keeper execution fee, escrowed per order at creation (token-dec).\nAt most `min_order_margin`.
fields.name: exec_fee

fields.doc: Dominant-side trade fee rate (`SCALAR_18`).
fields.name: fee_dom

fields.doc: Non-dominant-side trade fee rate (`SCALAR_18`).
fields.name: fee_non_dom

fields.doc: Velocity decay inside the decay band (`SCALAR_18`, per second^2).
fields.name: funding_decrease

fields.doc: Velocity acceleration as skew widens (`SCALAR_18`, per second^2).
fields.name: funding_increase

fields.doc: Saved-rate hard cap (`SCALAR_18`, per second).
fields.name: funding_max

fields.doc: Charged-rate floor (`SCALAR_18`, per second).
fields.name: funding_min

fields.doc: Impact fee denominator (token-dec). Every fill pays\n`notional * min(notional / impact_scalar, MAX_IMPACT_RATE)`.
fields.name: impact_scalar

fields.doc: Borrowing rate at full utilization (`SCALAR_18`, per second). In\n`[borrow_rate, MAX_BORROW_RATE]`.
fields.name: increased_borrow_rate

fields.doc: Initial margin rate (`SCALAR_18`). Max leverage is `1 / init_margin`.
fields.name: init_margin

fields.doc: Keeper share of trade, liquidation and vault fill fees (`SCALAR_18`).
fields.name: keeper_rate

fields.doc: Liquidation fee rate (`SCALAR_18`). Every liquidation charges\n`min(max(equity, 0), ceil(liq_fee * notional))`.
fields.name: liq_fee

fields.doc: Hard liquidation floor (`SCALAR_18`). Below `init_margin`.
fields.name: maintenance_margin

fields.doc: Per-side open-interest ceiling (token-dec). At least\n`max_position_notional`.
fields.name: max_open_interest

fields.doc:
Realized-profit haircut threshold (`SCALAR_18`), below 1. While a
side's pending PnL exceeds this fraction of half the vault, close
payouts scale by `allowance / side PnL`. Also the per-side profit cap
in share-pricing PnL.
fields.name: max_pnl_trader

fields.doc: Redeem gate (`SCALAR_18`). Redeems are blocked while a side's pending\nPnL exceeds this fraction of half the post-redeem balance. In\n`(0, adl_clear_target]`.
fields.name: max_pnl_withdraw

fields.doc: Maximum position notional (token-dec).
fields.name: max_position_notional

fields.doc: Utilization above which size increases on that side are blocked\n(`SCALAR_18`). Also each side's borrow-reserve denominator: capacity is\n`max_util_open * vault / 2`.
fields.name: max_util_open

fields.doc: Utilization above which withdrawals are blocked (`SCALAR_18`), so the\nvault keeps at least `reserved / max_util_withdraw` of backing. At\nleast `max_util_open`.
fields.name: max_util_withdraw

fields.doc: Vault balance ceiling enforced on deposit fills (token-dec).
fields.name: max_vault_balance

fields.doc: Minimum assets per deposit order (token-dec).
fields.name: min_deposit

fields.doc: Minimum posted margin per order, the dust floor (token-dec).
fields.name: min_order_margin

fields.doc: Minimum `|notional|` per order, the dust floor (token-dec). At most\n`min_position_notional`.
fields.name: min_order_notional

fields.doc: Minimum position notional (token-dec).
fields.name: min_position_notional

fields.doc: Decrease lock on newly added notional (seconds).
fields.name: notional_lock

fields.doc: Redeem fill fee rate on moved assets (`SCALAR_18`).
fields.name: redeem_fee

fields.doc: Redeem cooldown from a vault order's `created_at` (seconds). An\noperator liquidity-stickiness dial. `0` fills as soon as a\npost-creation price exists.
fields.name: redeem_lock

fields.doc: Kink utilization on the normalized `[0, 1]` reserve curve\n(`SCALAR_18`). Below 1.
fields.name: target_util

fields.doc: Skew band within which the rate decays (`SCALAR_18`). At most\n`threshold_stable_funding`.
fields.name: threshold_decrease_funding

fields.doc: Skew band within which the rate holds (`SCALAR_18`).
fields.name: threshold_stable_funding

function_v0.doc:
Replaces the contract WASM. Storage is kept as is, not migrated. It
does not change what future deploys install. `set_init_meta` does.

# Arguments

* `e` - Access to the Soroban environment.
* `new_wasm_hash` - The hash of an uploaded WASM blob.
* `operator` - The owner.

# Errors

* `OwnableError::OwnerNotSet` - If ownership was renounced.
* [`FactoryError::UpgradeNotOwner`] - If `operator` is not the owner.

# Notes

* Authorization for the owner is required, and `operator` must be the
owner.
function_v0.name: upgrade

function_v0.doc:
Returns `Some(Address)` if ownership is set, or `None` if ownership has
been renounced.

# Arguments

* `e` - Access to the Soroban environment.
function_v0.name: get_owner

function_v0.doc:
Initializes the factory with the installed WASM hashes and the
treasury address.

# Arguments

* `e` - Access to the Soroban environment.
* `owner` - The contract owner. It controls `set_init_meta` and
`upgrade`.
* `init_meta` - The `FactoryInitMeta` for future deploys.
function_v0.name: __constructor

function_v0.doc:
Accepts a pending ownership transfer.

# Arguments

* `e` - Access to the Soroban environment.

# Errors

* [`crate::role_transfer::RoleTransferError::NoPendingTransfer`] - If
there is no pending transfer to accept.

# Events

* topics - `["ownership_transfer_completed"]`
* data - `[new_owner: Address]`
function_v0.name: accept_ownership

function_v0.doc:
Renounces ownership of the contract.

Permanently removes the owner, disabling all functions gated by
`#[only_owner]`.

# Arguments

* `e` - Access to the Soroban environment.

# Errors

* [`OwnableError::TransferInProgress`] - If there is a pending ownership
transfer.
* [`OwnableError::OwnerNotSet`] - If the owner is not set.

# Notes

* Authorization for the current owner is required.
function_v0.name: renounce_ownership

function_v0.doc:
Initiates a 2-step ownership transfer to a new address.

Requires authorization from the current owner. The new owner must later
call `accept_ownership()` to complete the transfer.

# Arguments

* `e` - Access to the Soroban environment.
* `new_owner` - The proposed new owner.
* `live_until_ledger` - Ledger number until which the new owner can
accept. A value of `0` cancels any pending transfer.

# Errors

* [`OwnableError::OwnerNotSet`] - If the owner is not set.
* [`crate::role_transfer::RoleTransferError::NoPendingTransfer`] - If
trying to cancel a transfer that doesn't exist.
* [`crate::role_transfer::RoleTransferError::InvalidLiveUntilLedger`] -
If the specified ledger is in the past.
* [`crate::role_transfer::RoleTransferError::InvalidPendingAccount`] -
If the specified pending account is not the same as the provided `new`
address.

# Notes

* Authorization for the current owner is required.
function_v0.name: transfer_ownership
